lines.line: Stack Overflow faces Claude, with two lives each.
Stack Overflow fires its correction and its beam, and Claude answers with a line of dots.
Claude parries twice, but the beam catches it and knocks it out.
Then Stack Overflow is thrown off the page, so both are down to one life.
A low kick and another beam wear Claude down.
Claude goes over the edge, and Stack Overflow wins.
